id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

groups.description: Training groups to run in this training job.

title:
Represents a training job for running many {@link MlModel} trainings. All models should be within the scope of a single
{@link MlProject}.
Groups of training are specified in a list of {@link MlModel.Train.Group}. Each model training will be persisted as a
{@link MlModel.Train.Result}. Furthermore, the model trainings for this job can be aggregated through APIs on the
resulting {@link MlModel.Train.JobRun}.

See {@link MlModel.Train.Group}
See {@link MlModel.Train.Template}
See {@link MlModel.Train.Strategy}

Usage:
```python
train_template_1 = c3.MlModel.Train.Template(
    model=c3.MlModel(pipeline=..., xFeatures=..., yFeatures=...)
)
training_strategy_4blades = c3.MlModel.Train.Strategy(subjectFilter="blades == 4",
                                                      start="2022-01-05",
                                                      end="2022-02-05")
training_group_4blades = c3.MlModel.Train.Group(template=train_template_1,
                                                strategy=training_strategy_4blades)

training_strategy_3blades = c3.MlModel.Train.Strategy(subjectFilter="blades == 3",
                                                      groupBy="id",
                                                      start="2022-01-05",
                                                      end="2022-03-05")
training_group_3blades = c3.MlModel.Train.Group(template=train_template_1,
                                                strategy=training_strategy_3blades)

train_template_2 = c3.MlModel.Train.Template(
    model=c3.MlModel(pipeline=..., xFeatures=..., yFeatures=...),
    spec=c3.MlOperationRun(...)
)
training_strategy_5blades = c3.MlModel.Train.Strategy(subjectFilter="blades == 5",
                                                      start="2022-01-05",
                                                      end="2022-03-08")
training_group_5blades = c3.MlModel.Train.Group(template=train_template_2,
                                                strategy=training_strategy_5blades)

training_job = c3.MlModel.Train.Job(
     groups=[training_group_4blades, training_group_3blades, training_group_5blades])
     .create(returnInclude='this')

training_job_run = training_job.start()
training_job_result = training_job_run.result()
all_training_results = training_job_result.trainResults()
```
name: MlModel.Train.Job
